description: This file defines API route handlers for the Next.js application, specifically handling requests related to the Anthropic API. It includes request handling, authorization, proxying, and region configuration.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming requests, checks method and path permissions, performs authentication, and proxies the request.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Proxies the request to the Anthropic API, handling headers, timeout, and model restrictions.
